capabilities: Push and pull note content to and from HedgeDoc documents
Live-sync edits with remote collaborators, including their cursors
Create HedgeDoc documents from notes and notes from documents
Manage HedgeDoc accounts and session logins per server
Copy published and slide links and change document permissions
disambiguation: Not a general vault or device sync tool; it links individual notes to HedgeDoc documents on a server you configure.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13 or newer); mobile unsupported and HedgeDoc 2 not supported. Session cookies are kept in Obsidian's secret storage, and the README states there is no telemetry, advertising, paid features or remote code.
problem: Notes and their HedgeDoc documents are separate copies, so keeping the same text in both means copying it back and forth by hand.

relations.evidence: Sync Obsidian notes with HedgeDoc documents using frontmatter links and hedgesync.

summary: Links notes to HedgeDoc documents through a frontmatter property and syncs their content by push, pull or live two-way editing.
